cohort: 6936 late preterm and full-term infants born between 2016 and 2018 who were exclusively breastfed until discharge
finding: Early readmission of exclusively breastfed infants born by means of vaginal or cesarean delivery is multifactorial and associated with early pregnancy mental health issues.
mod_finding: The study examined factors associated with early postnatal readmission for infants born via vaginal birth and cesarean birth, finding similar readmission rates between the two modes of delivery.
